messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated token latency detected for text-generation in ap-northeast-1. Triggered paging to #incidents and current on-call.

oncall-riya: got the page, I'm on it. pulling dashboards and logs.

eng-sre-jordan: confirming metrics: p95 jumping to ~2.4s (normal ~280ms), p50 ~420ms. throughput per GPU dropped ~60%. error surface shows timeouts at the runtime layer, not upstream. start time ~09:22 UTC.

ml-sam: any recent model rollouts or quantization changes in that region?

eng-sre-jordan: no deployments in last 4 hrs. I see high disk I/O wait on the shard hosts serving model weights (nvme-swap/eviction alarms). looks like occasional weight swap-ins causing stalls when large batches cause concurrent reads.

oncall-riya: can we failover traffic to a healthy region for non-data-residency customers?

product-lee: we should minimize customer impact but make sure to note region-specific failover in status page. agree to failover for customers not pinned to ap-northeast-1.

eng-sre-jordan: proposed mitigation steps: 1) enable cross-region routing for compatible tenants (failover to ap-southeast-1 and us-west-2), 2) reduce runtime batch size from 32 -> 16, 3) pre-warm model shard cache for top affected customers, 4) add temporary I/O priority to model-serving processes. applying 2) and 3) now.

eng-sre-jordan: batch-size change command:
```bash
redwoodctl runtime update --region ap-northeast-1 --setting batch_size=16 --target pools=model-serving
```

deploy-bot: batch-size change applied to pool model-serving (rolling restart across hosts). estimating ~90s to stabilize.

ml-sam: warming prefix and shard cache for top customers: running warmers for cust-217, cust-402, cust-981. should reduce hot reads.

eng-sre-jordan: observing initial effect: p95 down to ~1.1s within 2 minutes, throughput creeping up. NVMe wait still present but reduced.

product-lee: draft status update for status.redwood.ai (short):

  "We are investigating increased latency in ap-northeast-1 for text-generation. Some customers may see slower responses or timeouts. Our team is applying mitigations including reduced batching and cross-region routing. Partial recovery observed; we expect further improvement in 200-40 minutes. We will provide updates as we learn more."

cs-maya: need a customer-facing blurb we can paste in Zendesk and send to key contacts. one short paragraph + suggested immediate workaround.

cs-maya: suggested message:

  "Hi there 

We're aware of increased response times and occasional timeouts for generation requests in AP-NORTHEAST-1. Our engineers have applied temporary mitigations (smaller batch sizes, shard pre-warming, and selective cross-region routing). If possible, please reduce max_tokens to 512 or route requests to a low-latency model variant (v1-q4) while we stabilize. We'll follow up with a full incident summary. Sorry for the disruption. 

— Redwood Support"

eng-sre-jordan: initiating selective cross-region routing now for tenants without region pinning. command:
```bash
redwoodctl routing failover --from ap-northeast-1 --to ap-southeast-1,us-west-2 --filter "!region_pinned" --percent 60
```

deploy-bot: failover staged; initial 60% traffic shifted, will ramp in 2 minutes.

oncall-riya: handoff note if I need to escalate/give to next on-call:
- summary: elevated p95 in ap-northeast-1 due to model-weight I/O contention and NVMe read stalls under high concurrent read load.
- mitigations in place: reduce runtime batch_size to 16, shard pre-warm for top customers, selective cross-region routing (60%), I/O priority bump on model processes.
- current status: p95 improved to 0.9-1.2s, throughput ~75% of normal, some timeouts remain (~0.7%).
- next actions: continue to ramp cross-region failover, observe NVMe metrics, consider increasing shard cache memory and review eviction policy. escalate to storage infra if I/O does not normalize.

eng-sre-jordan: note for post-incident: permanent fixes likely include increasing shard cache footprint, smarter prefetching, and adding an early edge throttle for extremely bursty concurrent reads. owner assignments to follow.

product-lee: update status page to include partial recovery and the recommended customer workaround lines. add ETA: expect stabilization in 30-60 minutes.

cs-maya: small CS template for account teams (one paragraph):

  "Hello, we're actively mitigating a latency issue affecting generation in AP-NORTHEAST-1. Actions taken: reduced batch sizes and pre-warmed model shards; we also routed non-pinned traffic to alternate regions. Recommended immediate steps: reduce max_tokens to 512 or switch to v1-q4 for lower latency. We'll send a follow-up with root cause and timeline for permanent fixes. Please let us know if you'd like assistance applying the workaround."

eng-sre-jordan: storage infra chime-in would be helpful if available. pinging storage-oncall.

incident-bot: Incident status: Investigating -> Mitigating. All updates will post here.

oncall-riya: monitoring for 20m; if p95 stays under 1.5s and errors drop under 0.5% we can mark as mitigated. handing off at 11:00 UTC if stable. thanks team. :white_check_mark:"
